system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Sherlock Holmes in dressing-gown and slippers, lean and sharp-eyed, drawing Dr. Watson into the room by the arm","action":"Holmes pulls Watson inward with one hand while swinging the door shut behind him, half-turned toward the visitor with a welcoming gesture","setting":"221B Baker Street sitting room, cluttered with books and papers, a settee against the wall","secondaryElements":"Stout, florid elderly Jabez Wilson in a dark tweed suit seated mid-conversation, glancing up with a startled expression; coal fire glowing in the grate; gas lamp lit beside the window","mood":"Brisk, warm, faintly comic intimacy with a hint of conspiracy","timeOfDay":"Autumn afternoon","composition":"Medium interior shot from the doorway, Holmes and Watson framed in the foreground, Wilson seated in the middle distance by the window in soft grey daylight"}
